config.install_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace/CEFABEX
node -e "if (Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]) < 24) throw new Error('CEFABEX requires Node.js 24 or later')"
npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
npm run build
npm test
config.start_skill:
# CEFABEX development
Use the existing checkout at /workspace/CEFABEX; cloud tasks are isolated, so do not create a Git worktree unless explicitly requested.
Use Node.js 24+. From /workspace/CEFABEX run npm ci if dependencies are missing. Start npm run dev -- --port 5173 in a long-running terminal. Check a local HTTP request returns the CEFABEX title. No user-facing loopback preview links.
Production checks: npm run build and npm test. Start npm run preview -- --port 4173, then run npm run test:browser. CHROMIUM_PATH can override /usr/bin/chromium. Media is local and no external credentials are required.
The enquiry form produces a copy/download brief, not a sent email. Add a real verified delivery endpoint before claiming submissions are delivered.
